# Africa only

fws >= 0.95 monoclonal filter, hmmIBD, single linkage clustering at IBD >= 0.95, retain one random representative per cluster

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
metadata <- read.csv(
  "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/metadata.csv",
  sep = ","
)%>%
  select(wgs_id, Country, fws)%>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_S[0-9]+$", "", wgs_id))  %>% 
  mutate(Sample = gsub("-D0", "_D0", Sample)) %>% 
  mutate(Sample = gsub("NG-A4488_", "", Sample)) %>% 
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_libLAN[0-9]+", "", Sample))%>%
  select(Sample,Country,fws)%>%
  mutate(type = "sample")
readr::write_tsv(metadata , "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/metadata_edit.csv")
```

```{bash}
conda activate fastq2matrix

# Filter out multiclonal samples
awk -F',' 'NR==1 {for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) {if($i=="fws") fws_col=i; if($i=="wgs_id") id_col=i}} NR>1 && $fws_col >= 0.95 {print $id_col}' ../metadata.csv > samples_0.95.csv

bcftools view -S samples_0.95.csv -o allsamples_fws_0.95.vcf.gz -O z /mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps.vcf.gz

# Index the output
bcftools index allsamples_fws_0.95.vcf.gz

# African samples only
bcftools view -S africa_only_samples.txt allsamples_fws_0.95.vcf.gz -Oz --force-samples -o africa_only_fws_0.95.vcf.gz

bcftools query -l africa_only_fws_0.95.vcf.gz | wc -l # 639

```

```{bash}

# Conversion to matrix
python ~/software/fastq2matrix/scripts/vcf2matrix.py \
    --vcf africa_only_fws_0.95.vcf.gz \
    --no-iupacgt \
    --na NA \
    --threads 32

```
```{bash}
# Calculate IBD
conda activate ibd

Rscript ~/software/malaria-hub/ibd/run_hmmIBD_per_category.R \
-d . \
-b africa_only_fws_0.95.mat.bin \
-m /mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/metadata_edit.csv \
-c sample \
--label_category type \
--label_fws fws \
--fws_th 0.95 \
--label_id Sample \
--maf 0.01 \
--na_char NA \
--remove_chr Pf3D7_API_v3,Pf_M76611

 ~/software/hmmIBD/hmmIBD -i hmmIBD_sample_maf0.01.txt -o hmmIBD_sample_maf0.01.out 

```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
metadata <- read.csv(
  "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/metadata.csv",
  sep = ","
)%>%
  select(wgs_id, Country, fws)%>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_S[0-9]+$", "", wgs_id))  %>% 
  mutate(Sample = gsub("-D0", "_D0", Sample)) %>% 
  mutate(Sample = gsub("NG-A4488_", "", Sample)) %>% 
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_libLAN[0-9]+", "", Sample))%>%
  select(Sample,Country,fws)%>%
  mutate(type = "sample")
readr::write_tsv(metadata , "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/metadata_edit.csv")

# Single linkage clustering of samples with IBD >= 0.95, retain one random
# representative per cluster.
library(igraph)

all_hmmibd_fract <- read.table("/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/hmmIBD_sample_maf0.01.out.hmm_fract.txt", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

high_ibd <- all_hmmibd_fract %>%
    filter(fract_sites_IBD >= 0.95)

# Build undirected graph: nodes = samples, edges = high-IBD pairs.
# Connected components are the single linkage clusters.
g <- graph_from_data_frame(
    high_ibd %>% select(sample1, sample2),
    directed = FALSE
)
comps <- components(g)

clusters_df <- tibble(
    Sample  = names(comps$membership),
    cluster = comps$membership
)

# Random representative per cluster (seeded for reproducibility)
set.seed(42)
representatives <- clusters_df %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_sample(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pull(Sample)

# Samples not in any high-IBD pair are all retained
all_in_pairs <- unique(c(high_ibd$sample1, high_ibd$sample2))
singletons   <- setdiff(metadata$Sample, all_in_pairs)

samples_to_keep <- c(singletons, representatives)
samples_to_drop <- setdiff(all_in_pairs, representatives)

remaining_samples <- metadata %>%
    filter(Sample %in% samples_to_keep)

# Diagnostics
message("Total samples: ", nrow(metadata))
message("High-IBD pairs: ", nrow(high_ibd))
message("Clusters: ", comps$no)
message("Cluster size distribution:")
print(table(comps$csize))
message("Samples retained: ", length(samples_to_keep),
        " (", length(singletons), " singletons + ",
        length(representatives), " cluster representatives)")
message("Samples dropped: ", length(samples_to_drop))

readr::write_tsv(
    remaining_samples,
    "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/metadata_remaining_cluster_dedup.tsv"
)

readr::write_tsv(
    tibble(Sample = samples_to_drop),
    "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/cluster_dedup_samples_to_remove.tsv",
    col_names = FALSE
)

readr::write_tsv(
    clusters_df %>% arrange(cluster, Sample),
    "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/ibd_clusters.tsv"
)

```

```{bash}
conda activate fastq2matrix

wc -l /mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/cluster_dedup_samples_to_remove.tsv

# remove non-representative cluster members from the vcf and redo the pca
bcftools view -S ^cluster_dedup_samples_to_remove.tsv africa_only_fws_0.95.vcf.gz -Oz -o africa_only_fws_0.95_cluster_dedup.vcf.gz

bcftools index africa_only_fws_0.95_cluster_dedup.vcf.gz

plink --vcf africa_only_fws_0.95_cluster_dedup.vcf.gz --distance square --double-id --allow-extra-chr --out cluster_dedup

```

```{r}
library(showtext)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ape)

workdir <- "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal" # Working directory with plink files
prefix <- "cluster_dedup" # Prefix for plink files
metadata <- "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/metadata_remaining_cluster_dedup.tsv" # File path to metadata

calc_variance_explained <- function(pc_points) {
    vars <- round(pc_points$eig / sum(pc_points$eig) * 100, 1)
    names(vars) <- paste0("PC", seq_len(length(vars)))
    vars
}

# METADATA
met <- read.table(metadata, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE)

#### DIST#
dist <- read.table(file.path(workdir, paste0(prefix, ".dist")), header = FALSE)
id <- read.table(file.path(workdir, paste0(prefix, ".dist.id")))

desc <- id %>% left_join(met, by = c("V1" = "Sample"))
# desc <- id %>% left_join(met, by = c("V1" = "sample_id"))

dist_m <- as.matrix(dist)
colnames(dist_m) <- desc$V1
rownames(dist_m) <- desc$V1

# PCA ##
cmd <- cmdscale(dist_m, k = 10, eig = TRUE, x.ret = TRUE) # Multidimensional Scaling - might take a while
# saveRDS(cmd, paste0(prefix, ".dist.rds") # save to RDS format
#cmd <- readRDS(file.path(workdir, paste0(prefix, ".dist.rds"))
vars <- calc_variance_explained(cmd) # Calculations of variance explained

# Overlay region, country info
df <- as.data.frame(cmd$points, stringsAsFactors = F)
df$country <- gsub("_", " ", desc$Country)
#df$region <- gsub("_", " ", desc$region)
df$sample_id <- rownames(matrix)
colnames(df) <- gsub("V", "PC", colnames(df))

color_by <- "country" # specify if coloured by region or country
country_colors <- c(
  "Ethiopia" = "#E41A1C", 
  "Kenya" = "#377EB8", 
  "Tanzania" = "#4DAF4A",
  "Uganda" = "#984EA3",   
  "Sudan" = "#FF7F00",  
  "Ghana" = "#FFFF33", 
  "Nigeria" = "#A65628",
  "Mali" = "#eb88d4",
  "Eritrea" = "darkblue",
  "India" = "black",
  "Thailand" = "darkgreen",
  "Myanmar" = "lightsalmon"
)

# Graph with PC1 an PC2
p <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2,
       color = !!sym(color_by))) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_manual(values = country_colors) +
    labs(x = paste0("PC1", " (", vars["PC1"], "%)"),
            y = paste0("PC2", " (", vars["PC2"], "%)")) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(plot = p, filename = file.path(workdir, "figs/PC_12_africa_monoclonal_high_ibd_removed.pdf"))


# Graph with PC1 and PC3
q <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC3,
       color = !!sym(color_by))) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_manual(values = country_colors) +
    labs(x = paste0("PC1", " (", vars["PC1"], "%)"),
            y = paste0("PC3", " (", vars["PC3"], "%)")) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(plot = q, filename = file.path(workdir, "figs/PC_13_africa_monoclonal_high_ibd_removed.pdf"))

# Export dist_m to .newick to make neighbour joining tree
tree <- nj(dist_m)
write.tree(phy = tree, file = file.path(workdir, paste0(prefix, ".newick")))

```

## Africa monoclonal — region-coloured plots (standalone)

Re-reads the plink `.dist` files and reruns `cmdscale` from scratch, so this chunk can be run on its own without rerunning the full pipeline above.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

workdir  <- "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal"
prefix   <- "cluster_dedup"
metadata <- "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/metadata_remaining_cluster_dedup.tsv"

calc_variance_explained <- function(pc_points) {
    vars <- round(pc_points$eig / sum(pc_points$eig) * 100, 1)
    names(vars) <- paste0("PC", seq_len(length(vars)))
    vars
}

met  <- read.table(metadata, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE)
dist <- read.table(file.path(workdir, paste0(prefix, ".dist")), header = FALSE)
id   <- read.table(file.path(workdir, paste0(prefix, ".dist.id")))

desc <- id %>% left_join(met, by = c("V1" = "Sample"))

dist_m <- as.matrix(dist)
colnames(dist_m) <- desc$V1
rownames(dist_m) <- desc$V1

cmd  <- cmdscale(dist_m, k = 10, eig = TRUE, x.ret = TRUE)
vars <- calc_variance_explained(cmd)

df <- as.data.frame(cmd$points, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
df$country   <- gsub("_", " ", desc$Country)
df$sample_id <- rownames(df)
colnames(df) <- gsub("V", "PC", colnames(df))

country_to_region <- c(
  "Kenya"    = "East Africa",
  "Tanzania" = "East Africa",
  "Uganda"   = "East Africa",
  "Ethiopia" = "Horn of Africa",
  "Eritrea"  = "Horn of Africa",
  "Sudan"    = "Horn of Africa",
  "Ghana"    = "West Africa",
  "Nigeria"  = "West Africa",
  "Mali"     = "West Africa"
)
region_colors <- c(
  "East Africa"    = "#377EB8",
  "Horn of Africa" = "#E41A1C",
  "West Africa"    = "#4DAF4A"
)
df$region <- country_to_region[df$country]

p_region <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = region)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_manual(values = region_colors) +
    labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", vars["PC1"], "%)"),
         y = paste0("PC2 (", vars["PC2"], "%)")) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(plot = p_region, filename = file.path(workdir, "figs/PC_12_africa_monoclonal_high_ibd_removed_region.pdf"))

q_region <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC3, color = region)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_manual(values = region_colors) +
    labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", vars["PC1"], "%)"),
         y = paste0("PC3 (", vars["PC3"], "%)")) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(plot = q_region, filename = file.path(workdir, "figs/PC_13_africa_monoclonal_high_ibd_removed_region.pdf"))
```

# Africa + India analysis

Same workflow as above (fws >= 0.95 monoclonal filter, hmmIBD, single linkage clustering at IBD >= 0.95, retain one random representative per cluster), but with Indian samples included. Sample list is `africa_India_only_samples.txt`.

```{bash}
conda activate fastq2matrix

# Subset the monoclonal VCF to Africa + India samples
bcftools view -S africa_India_only_samples.txt allsamples_fws_0.95.vcf.gz -Oz --force-samples -o africa_india_fws_0.95.vcf.gz
bcftools index africa_india_fws_0.95.vcf.gz

bcftools query -l africa_india_fws_0.95.vcf.gz | wc -l
```

```{bash}
# Conversion to matrix
python ~/software/fastq2matrix/scripts/vcf2matrix.py \
    --vcf africa_india_fws_0.95.vcf.gz \
    --no-iupacgt \
    --na NA \
    --threads 32
```

```{bash}
# Calculate IBD
conda activate ibd

Rscript ~/software/malaria-hub/ibd/run_hmmIBD_per_category.R \
-d . \
-b africa_india_fws_0.95.mat.bin \
-m /mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/metadata_edit.csv \
-c sample \
--label_category type \
--label_fws fws \
--fws_th 0.95 \
--label_id Sample \
--maf 0.01 \
--na_char NA \
--remove_chr Pf3D7_API_v3,Pf_M76611

# hmmIBD output prefix is suffixed with _africa_india to avoid clobbering the africa-only run
~/software/hmmIBD/hmmIBD -i hmmIBD_sample_maf0.01.txt -o hmmIBD_sample_maf0.01_africa_india.out
```

```{r}
# Single linkage clustering of Africa+India samples with IBD >= 0.95,
# retain one random representative per cluster.
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(igraph)

metadata <- read.csv(
  "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/metadata.csv",
  sep = ","
) %>%
  select(wgs_id, Country, fws) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_S[0-9]+$", "", wgs_id)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("-D0", "_D0", Sample)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("NG-A4488_", "", Sample)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_libLAN[0-9]+", "", Sample)) %>%
  select(Sample, Country, fws) %>%
  mutate(type = "sample")

# Restrict metadata to the Africa+India sample set actually used
ai_samples <- read.table(
    "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/africa_India_only_samples.txt",
    header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)$V1
metadata_ai <- metadata %>% filter(Sample %in% ai_samples)

all_hmmibd_fract <- read.table(
    "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/hmmIBD_sample_maf0.01_africa_india.out.hmm_fract.txt",
    header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

high_ibd <- all_hmmibd_fract %>%
    filter(fract_sites_IBD >= 0.95)

g <- graph_from_data_frame(
    high_ibd %>% select(sample1, sample2),
    directed = FALSE
)
comps <- components(g)

clusters_df <- tibble(
    Sample  = names(comps$membership),
    cluster = comps$membership
)

set.seed(42)
representatives <- clusters_df %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_sample(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pull(Sample)

all_in_pairs <- unique(c(high_ibd$sample1, high_ibd$sample2))
singletons   <- setdiff(metadata_ai$Sample, all_in_pairs)

samples_to_keep <- c(singletons, representatives)
samples_to_drop <- setdiff(all_in_pairs, representatives)

remaining_samples <- metadata_ai %>%
    filter(Sample %in% samples_to_keep)

message("Total Africa+India samples: ", nrow(metadata_ai))
message("High-IBD pairs: ", nrow(high_ibd))
message("Clusters: ", comps$no)
message("Cluster size distribution:")
print(table(comps$csize))
message("Samples retained: ", length(samples_to_keep),
        " (", length(singletons), " singletons + ",
        length(representatives), " cluster representatives)")
message("Samples dropped: ", length(samples_to_drop))

readr::write_tsv(
    remaining_samples,
    "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/metadata_remaining_cluster_dedup_africa_india.tsv"
)

readr::write_tsv(
    tibble(Sample = samples_to_drop),
    "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/cluster_dedup_samples_to_remove_africa_india.tsv",
    col_names = FALSE
)

readr::write_tsv(
    clusters_df %>% arrange(cluster, Sample),
    "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/ibd_clusters_africa_india.tsv"
)
```

# All-samples PCA with dominant-allele genotypes

For samples with heterozygous calls, replace the GT with the allele that has the higher read depth in `FORMAT/AD`. Random tie-break (seed 42) when AD is tied. `bcftools norm -m -any` is run first to ensure biallelic representation. This keeps all samples (including multiclonal) but collapses within-host noise so each sample contributes a single dominant haplotype.

## Preprocessing — dominant-allele transform on the full VCF

```{bash}
conda activate fastq2matrix

# Normalise (split any multi-allelics) then replace heterozygous calls with the
# dominant allele based on FORMAT/AD. Random tie-break (seed 42 in awk).
bcftools norm -m -any /mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen.filt.csq.bi.GT.miss0.2.vqslod.filt.snps.vcf.gz -Ou \
  | bcftools view -Ov \
  | awk 'BEGIN { srand(42); OFS = "\t" }
    /^#/ { print; next }
    {
      n = split($9, fmt, ":"); gt_idx = 0; ad_idx = 0
      for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        if (fmt[i] == "GT") gt_idx = i
        if (fmt[i] == "AD") ad_idx = i
      }
      if (gt_idx == 0 || ad_idx == 0) { print; next }
      for (s = 10; s <= NF; s++) {
        m = split($s, vals, ":")
        gt = vals[gt_idx]
        if (gt == "0/1" || gt == "1/0" || gt == "0|1" || gt == "1|0") {
          ad = vals[ad_idx]
          if (ad != "." && ad != "") {
            split(ad, ads, ",")
            if (ads[1] != "." && ads[2] != "." && ads[1] != "" && ads[2] != "") {
              ref_d = ads[1] + 0; alt_d = ads[2] + 0
              if (ref_d > alt_d)      new_gt = "0/0"
              else if (alt_d > ref_d) new_gt = "1/1"
              else                    new_gt = (rand() < 0.5) ? "0/0" : "1/1"
              if (gt ~ /\|/) sub("/", "|", new_gt)
              vals[gt_idx] = new_gt
              new_field = vals[1]
              for (j = 2; j <= m; j++) new_field = new_field ":" vals[j]
              $s = new_field
            }
          }
        }
      }
      print
    }' \
  | bcftools view -Oz -o allsamples_dom.vcf.gz

bcftools index allsamples_dom.vcf.gz
bcftools query -l allsamples_dom.vcf.gz | wc -l
```

```{r}
    labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", vars["PC1"], "%)"),
         y = paste0("PC3 (", vars["PC3"], "%)")) +
    theme_classic() +
```


```{bash}
# Calculate IBD
conda activate ibd

Rscript ~/software/malaria-hub/ibd/run_hmmIBD_per_category.R \
-d . \
-b africa_india_dom.mat.bin \
-m /mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/metadata_edit.csv \
-c sample \
--label_category type \
--label_fws fws \
--fws_th 0 \
--label_id Sample \
--maf 0.01 \
--na_char NA \
--remove_chr Pf3D7_API_v3,Pf_M76611

~/software/hmmIBD/hmmIBD -i hmmIBD_sample_maf0.01.txt -o hmmIBD_sample_maf0.01_africa_india_dom.out
```

```{r}
# Single linkage clustering of Africa+India all-samples (dom) at IBD >= 0.95,
# retain one random representative per cluster.
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(igraph)

metadata <- read.csv(
  "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/metadata.csv",
  sep = ","
) %>%
  select(wgs_id, Country, fws) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_S[0-9]+$", "", wgs_id)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("-D0", "_D0", Sample)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("NG-A4488_", "", Sample)) %>%
  mutate(Sample = gsub("_libLAN[0-9]+", "", Sample)) %>%
  select(Sample, Country, fws) %>%
  mutate(type = "sample")

ai_samples <- read.table(
    "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/africa_India_only_samples.txt",
    header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)$V1
metadata_ai <- metadata %>% filter(Sample %in% ai_samples)

all_hmmibd_fract <- read.table(
    "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/hmmIBD_sample_maf0.01_africa_india_dom.out.hmm_fract.txt",
    header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

high_ibd <- all_hmmibd_fract %>%
    filter(fract_sites_IBD >= 0.95)

g <- graph_from_data_frame(
    high_ibd %>% select(sample1, sample2),
    directed = FALSE
)
comps <- components(g)

clusters_df <- tibble(
    Sample  = names(comps$membership),
    cluster = comps$membership
)

set.seed(42)
representatives <- clusters_df %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_sample(n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pull(Sample)

all_in_pairs <- unique(c(high_ibd$sample1, high_ibd$sample2))
singletons   <- setdiff(metadata_ai$Sample, all_in_pairs)

samples_to_keep <- c(singletons, representatives)
samples_to_drop <- setdiff(all_in_pairs, representatives)

remaining_samples <- metadata_ai %>%
    filter(Sample %in% samples_to_keep)

message("Total Africa+India all-samples (dom): ", nrow(metadata_ai))
message("High-IBD pairs: ", nrow(high_ibd))
message("Clusters: ", comps$no)
message("Cluster size distribution:")
print(table(comps$csize))
message("Samples retained: ", length(samples_to_keep),
        " (", length(singletons), " singletons + ",
        length(representatives), " cluster representatives)")
message("Samples dropped: ", length(samples_to_drop))

readr::write_tsv(
    remaining_samples,
    "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/metadata_remaining_cluster_dedup_africa_india_dom.tsv"
)

readr::write_tsv(
    tibble(Sample = samples_to_drop),
    "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/cluster_dedup_samples_to_remove_africa_india_dom.tsv",
    col_names = FALSE
)

readr::write_tsv(
    clusters_df %>% arrange(cluster, Sample),
    "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/ibd_clusters_africa_india_dom.tsv"
)
```

```{bash}
conda activate fastq2matrix

wc -l /mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/cluster_dedup_samples_to_remove_africa_india_dom.tsv

bcftools view -S ^cluster_dedup_samples_to_remove_africa_india_dom.tsv africa_india_dom.vcf.gz -Oz -o africa_india_dom_cluster_dedup.vcf.gz
bcftools index africa_india_dom_cluster_dedup.vcf.gz

```

```{r}
library(showtext)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ape)

workdir  <- "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal"
prefix   <- "cluster_dedup_africa_india_dom"
metadata <- "/mnt/storage13/leen/popgen_ethiopia_WGS/012026_pf_mgen_ug_india_eritrea_ethiopia_popgen/pca/removal_similar_samples_africa_monoclonal/metadata_remaining_cluster_dedup_africa_india_dom.tsv"

calc_variance_explained <- function(pc_points) {
    vars <- round(pc_points$eig / sum(pc_points$eig) * 100, 1)
    names(vars) <- paste0("PC", seq_len(length(vars)))
    vars
}

met  <- read.table(metadata, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE)
dist <- read.table(file.path(workdir, paste0(prefix, ".dist")), header = FALSE)
id   <- read.table(file.path(workdir, paste0(prefix, ".dist.id")))

desc <- id %>% left_join(met, by = c("V1" = "Sample"))

dist_m <- as.matrix(dist)
colnames(dist_m) <- desc$V1
rownames(dist_m) <- desc$V1

cmd  <- cmdscale(dist_m, k = 10, eig = TRUE, x.ret = TRUE)
vars <- calc_variance_explained(cmd)

df <- as.data.frame(cmd$points, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
df$country   <- gsub("_", " ", desc$Country)
df$sample_id <- rownames(df)
colnames(df) <- gsub("V", "PC", colnames(df))

color_by <- "country"
country_colors <- c(
  "Ethiopia" = "#E41A1C",
  "Kenya" = "#377EB8",
  "Tanzania" = "#4DAF4A",
  "Uganda" = "#984EA3",
  "Sudan" = "#FF7F00",
  "Ghana" = "#FFFF33",
  "Nigeria" = "#A65628",
  "Mali" = "#eb88d4",
  "Eritrea" = "darkblue",
  "India" = "black",
  "Thailand" = "darkgreen",
  "Myanmar" = "lightsalmon"
)

p <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = !!sym(color_by))) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_manual(values = country_colors) +
    labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", vars["PC1"], "%)"),
         y = paste0("PC2 (", vars["PC2"], "%)")) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(plot = p, filename = file.path(workdir, "figs/PC_12_africa_india_allsamples_dom.pdf"))

q <- ggplot(data = df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC3, color = !!sym(color_by))) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_manual(values = country_colors) +
    labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", vars["PC1"], "%)"),
         y = paste0("PC3 (", vars["PC3"], "%)")) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(plot = q, filename = file.path(workdir, "figs/PC_13_africa_india_allsamples_dom.pdf"))

tree <- nj(dist_m)
write.tree(phy = tree, file = file.path(workdir, paste0(prefix, ".newick")))
```
